_what: Every journey Unbrowse promises a person or their agent, one entry each (UNB-235). Gathered on 21 Nov 2026 from README.md, PRODUCT.md, skills/, the landing page, the node's MCP tools, the unb and unbrowse-node commands, the window's screens, the task gate's bank, and the UNB tickets marked done since 1 Nov 2026. A journey is covered when a QA step names it: a check in checklist.md (its `Journeys:` line, walked by Claude), a step in mcp-journey.json (its `journeys`, walked with no model), a job named in `runs_in` that runs on every push to staging (`<workflow>#<job>`), or a task of the gate bank in `bank` (the slice runs on every push, the whole bank nightly). `waived` says, in words a person can check, why no CI run can walk it. journey_coverage.py fails the run when a journey has none of these, or a step names a journey that isn't here. `picture` says what the step's picture must show for it to prove the journey.

journeys.expected: First reply how learned (or called), result holds the page's items; second how called, same kind of result.
journeys.picture: the page the goal was asked of, and the reply's items readable

journeys.expected: The second reply is how called on the same route id, with stories about the new value.
journeys.picture: the reply drawn: the second value's stories

journeys.promise: The release's disk image, archive and wheel hold the node, unb, the browser and the window, and they run.
journeys.waived: Built and signed only by release.yml, which runs on a release, never on a push to staging; its 'Check the programs run' step runs them. QA runs the same programs built from the pushed commit.

journeys.promise: Cursor and other HTTP clients reach the node at POST http://127.0.0.1:7788/mcp; a plain bearer header is refused unless bearer is turned on.
journeys.waived: Every QA node accepts bearer tokens (the model-free check and the bank need it), so the refusal can't be shown there, and the streamed reply the HTTP path gives is the one unb mcp reads on every QA step.

journeys.promise: Add funds in the window by card, Apple Pay, bank or USDC; unbrowse money prints the balance.
source: README.md: Add funds in the window
journeys.waived: A real payment through Circle's onramp, and no Arc network names a deployment the QA node could use.

journeys.promise: Another contributor's route is fetched and paid for within the owner's limits, and run locally.
source: docs/start/your-first-call.md: Another contributor's route costs its fetch fee
journeys.waived: Needs peers on the network and funded payments; QA nodes stay off the network by design.

journeys.promise: A route used enough is listed; its share of each fetch fee is cashed out to the owner's wallet.
journeys.waived: Needs a second peer, a deployed settlement contract and funds.

journeys.promise: The owner links a wallet with email or Google at unbrowse.ai/link.
source: docs/ONBOARDING.md: links one, with email or Google
journeys.waived: Needs a real Privy account and the live relay.

journeys.promise: A ChatGPT user adds Unbrowse as an app and signs in with ChatGPT's own Connect button.
journeys.waived: Needs ChatGPT and a Privy account on the hosted gateway; the node's MCP app view itself is covered by mcp-app-answer-view.

journeys.promise: An agent fills a card by reference; above the card's limit the owner approves in the window (or from Telegram) and the agent never sees the card.
journeys.waived: A card enters the vault only through vault card add's interactive prompt, approval needs a person, and a real checkout charges money.

journeys.promise: When a site needs the owner to sign in or type a code, the owner answers from Telegram.
journeys.waived: Needs the owner's Telegram bot and a person to answer it.

journeys.promise: A stranger reaching a node over the peer network sees only its public tools and can't use the owner's sessions.
journeys.waived: Needs the peer network; QA nodes stay off it. The node's own tests hold the public tool list (remote.rs PUBLIC_TOOLS).

journeys.promise: Website passkeys are enrolled when the owner signs in by hand, and passkey off or never stops it.
journeys.waived: Needs a site with real WebAuthn and a person signing in by hand.

journeys.promise: Agents run as their own OS user, unable to read the owner's token.
journeys.waived: Needs root on a throwaway machine; the runner's user isn't.

journeys.promise: The owner excludes a site or pauses the node in Settings, and agents are told so.
journeys.waived: Set only by clicking in the window's Settings, and the runner's window can't be clicked (no accessibility permission); the screen itself is pictured by window-screens.

journeys.promise: When a site changes its call, the node re-walks the route's page and retries once.
journeys.waived: Needs a site that changes its API between two calls on purpose; live sites don't, on cue.

journeys.promise: A release build verifies and installs the next release by itself, then restarts.
journeys.waived: Needs a signed release in the registry; a QA node is a source build, which never updates (source-build-never-updates).

journeys.promise: unbrowse-map: browse a site twice in a headed browser and learn whether its call replays over plain HTTP.
journeys.waived: A developer's skill that needs a headed browser driven by a person twice.

journeys.promise: On unbrowse.ai a visitor looks up a site and copies the install line for their agent.
journeys.waived: Lives in the unbrowse-landing repository, tested by its own checks.
